title: Phalanges of the hand (palmar)
attribution: 3D anatomy from Z-Anatomy, built on BodyParts3D (CC BY-SA). Rendered in Blender, with surface detail added by an image model.

structures.name: Proximal phalanx of 1st digit
objects: Proximal phalanx of first finger of hand.r

rows: Location
First of the two bones of the thumb beyond the palm. The thumb has no middle phalanx.
Articulates with
1st metacarpal and the distal phalanx of the thumb.

structures.name: Proximal phalanx of 2nd digit
objects: Proximal phalanx of second finger of hand.r

rows: Location
First of the three bones of the index finger.
Articulates with
2nd metacarpal, at the metacarpophalangeal joint, and the middle phalanx, at the proximal interphalangeal joint.

structures.name: Middle phalanx of 2nd digit
objects: Middle phalanx of second finger of hand.r

rows: Location
Second of the three bones of the index finger.
Articulates with
Proximal phalanx, at the proximal interphalangeal joint, and distal phalanx, at the distal interphalangeal joint.
Features
Flexor digitorum superficialis inserts on its sides.

structures.name: Distal phalanx of 1st digit
objects: Distal phalanx of first finger of hand.r

rows: Location
Bone at the tip of the thumb.
Articulates with
Proximal phalanx of the thumb, at the interphalangeal joint.
Features
Flexor pollicis longus inserts on the palmar side of its base and extensor pollicis longus on the dorsal side.

Features
